== Scope and result ==
Proofread completed 29 October 2026 by Memory Core ChatGPT. Compared all 310 current remastered card images with their 310 original scan counterparts and read the card-list lore and game-text cells. Downloaded image hashes were verified. Suspected discrepancies were enlarged for a second visual check.

This report records 37 findings across 36 cards. It is a correction queue, not a statement that the images have been repaired. No card images or card-list text were changed during this proofread. Low-resolution originals still limit certainty about fine punctuation.

Bill's approved wording takes precedence over the original scan. Intentional blank game-text boxes remain blank. Approved changes to See You At The Rendezvous, Jedi Rocks, Griff Mirtong, Corellian Slip and the other previously reviewed cards are preserved.

== Preserved choices and separate follow-up ==
* Droid Overboard: retain the grammatical cleanup that removes 'during' from 'during when'.
* Ben?: the source and remaster share an awkward modifier in the lore. Any rewrite is an editorial decision, not a transcription correction.
* Security Sweep: find distinct artwork; it shares its image with Imperial Detachments.
* Disciplinary Actions: retain the selected batch7-v5 candidate and all alternatives for later art review.
* Scum And Villainy and Imperial Command: the base/combo image filenames appear swapped, although the card-list rows show the appropriate image. Treat any filename cleanup separately from text fixes.
